Sets the Secure attribute of any JSESSIONID cookies associated with the web application. Allowed values are as follows: true — Sets Secure to true. false — Sets Secure to false. dynamic — The JSESSIONID cookie inherits the Secure setting of the request that initiated the session. To set the Secure attribute of a JSESSIONIDSSO cookie, use the ssoCookieSecure virtual-server property. For details, see create-virtual-server(1).
